location_change.from_location: Beijing Capital International Airport (北京首都国际机场), Shunyi District, Beijing
location_change.to_location: Kunming Changshui International Airport (昆明长水国际机场), Guandu District, Kunming
location_change.notes_base: Direct flight, 4h05m. CA4172: PEK departs 11:40, arrives Kunming (KMG) 15:45. Aircraft: Airbus A320neo. Depart home ~08:30, arrive PEK T3 by 09:30 for check-in. Arrive Kunming 15:45 — time for afternoon visit to Dounan Flower Market and evening across-the-bridge noodles (过桥米线). Airport transfer to city center: ~31km, ~41 minutes by taxi/DiDi, approx. CNY 80-120. Baggage allowance: 1 checked bag (23kg) + 1 carry-on per person. Book 4-6 weeks in advance (expect CNY 600-1000 economy). Data source: duffel_flights
location_change.notes_local: 直飞，飞行时间约4小时5分钟。CA4172：北京首都机场11:40出发，15:45抵达昆明长水国际机场。机型：空客A320neo。建议08:30出发，09:30到达首都机场T3航站楼办理值机。15:45抵达昆明，下午可去斗南花卉市场，晚上吃过桥米线。机场到市区约31公里，打滴滴或出租车约41分钟，约80-120元。行李额：每人1件托运行李（23公斤）+1件手提行李。建议提前4-6周预订，经济舱约600-1000元。数据来源：duffel_flights

route_1.name_base: Kunming Changshui Airport to Hotel (City Center)
route_1.name_local: 昆明长水国际机场 → 市区酒店
route_1.notes_base: Take taxi or DiDi from airport to city center hotel. Distance 30.9km, approximately 41 minutes (Gaode Maps: 2458 seconds / 60 = 41 min). Also consider Airport Shuttle Bus (机场大巴) for CNY 25 per person — takes ~60-70 minutes but cheaper. Express train (空港快轨) not available for whole city center yet. Data source: gaode_maps
route_1.notes_local: 从机场打出租车或滴滴到市区酒店，约30.9公里，约41分钟（高德地图：2458秒/60≈41分钟）。也可乘坐机场大巴，每人约25元，但需60-70分钟。数据来源：gaode_maps

route_2.name_local: 酒店 → 斗南花卉市场（下午）
route_2.notes_base: Short DiDi/taxi from city center hotel to Dounan Flower Market (斗南花卉市场). Distance 6.7km, approximately 17 minutes. Dounan is the largest fresh flower trading market in Asia — best visited late afternoon (15:00-18:00) when fresh batches arrive. Data source: gaode_maps
route_2.notes_local: 从市区酒店打滴滴到斗南花卉市场，约6.7公里，约17分钟。斗南是亚洲最大的花卉交易市场，建议下午15:00-18:00前往，新鲜花卉最多。数据来源：gaode_maps

location_change.from_location: Kunming South Railway Station (昆明南站), Chenggong District, Kunming
location_change.to_location: Lijiang Railway Station (丽江站), Gucheng District, Lijiang
location_change.cost_type_base: Second class seat, per person (approx. CNY 176)
location_change.notes_base: High-speed train on the Yunnan Inter-City Railway (云南城际铁路) Kunming-Dali-Lijiang HSR line. Multiple morning departures from Kunming South Station (昆明南站): typical options around 08:00-10:00. Journey time approximately 3h00-3h30. Second class (二等座) approx. CNY 176 per person; first class (一等座) approx. CNY 276. Recommended: 09:00 departure for comfortable morning schedule. Arrive Lijiang ~12:15, then PICK UP RENTAL CAR at Lijiang Station area (Shenzhou Zuchē / 神州租车 or similar). Recommended SUV: Toyota RAV4 or equivalent for Yunnan mountain roads. Rental car booked for Days 3-9 (7 days). Hotel-to-station by DiDi: ~8km, ~20 min from Kunming city center to Kunming South Station. Book train on 12306.cn or app 1-2 weeks in advance. Data source: gaode_maps / China Railway schedule knowledge
location_change.notes_local: 云南城际铁路昆明-大理-丽江高铁。昆明南站每天多班次，上午约08:00-10:00均有发车。全程约3小时至3.5小时。二等座约176元/人，一等座约276元/人。建议乘坐约09:00出发的班次，约12:15抵达丽江站。到站后立即在丽江站附近取租车（神州租车等），租用SUV（如丰田RAV4）供第3-9天自驾使用（7天）。从昆明市区酒店到昆明南站约8公里，约20分钟。请提前1-2周在12306.cn或手机APP预订。数据来源：gaode_maps / 中国铁路班次资料

route_1.name_base: Lijiang Station to Accommodation (Rental Car Pickup)
route_1.name_local: 丽江站取车 → 入住住宿
route_1.departure_point_base: Lijiang Railway Station — Car Rental Counter
route_1.cost_type_base: 7-day SUV rental approx. CNY 400-600/day (split between 2 people = CNY 200-300/person/day)
route_1.cost_type_local: 7天SUV租车约400-600元/天（两人均摊约200-300元/人/天）
route_1.notes_base: Pick up rental car at Lijiang Railway Station upon arrival (~12:15). Recommended: SUV such as Toyota RAV4, Haval H6, or similar for Yunnan mountain roads. Rental companies near Lijiang Station: Shenzhou Zuchē (神州租车), Yīhǎi Zuchē (一嗨租车), Zulin (租联). Estimated 7-day SUV rental cost: CNY 2,800-4,200 total = approx. USD 385-580 total (USD 55-83/day per car). Drive from station to accommodation: approximately 10km, ~25 minutes depending on resort location. Note: Lijiang Old Town inner streets are pedestrian-only — rural resorts around Shuhe (束河) or beyond can be reached by car. Car enables all Days 3-9 activities. Data source: gaode_maps / knowledge
route_1.notes_local: 约12:15抵达丽江站后在附近租车柜台取车。推荐SUV车型（如丰田RAV4、哈弗H6等），适合云南山区路况。丽江站附近租车公司：神州租车、一嗨租车、租联等。7天SUV估价：约2800-4200元（约200-300元/人/天）。从丽江站到住宿地约10公里，约25分钟（具体看住宿位置）。古城内为步行街，束河古镇周边的田园民宿可直接开车到达。此车用于第3-9天全程。数据来源：gaode_maps / 知识

route_1.name_base: Park rental car and settle into Dali Old Town
route_1.cost_type_base: Included in rental (parking at Old Town gate: approx. CNY 10-20/day)
route_1.cost_type_local: 含在租车费用内（古城停车场约10-20元/天）
route_1.notes_base: Park at designated lots near Dali Old Town gates (e.g., South Gate parking area). Dali Old Town pedestrian inner streets are car-free — park outside and walk in. Parking costs approximately CNY 10-20 per day. Data source: gaode_maps
route_1.notes_local: 在大理古城城门口停车场停车（如南门停车区）。大理古城内部为步行街，无法开车进入，停好车后步行至住所。停车费约10-20元/天。数据来源：gaode_maps

location_change.cost_type_base: Highway toll approx. CNY 60-80 per trip (split 2 people = CNY 30-40/person)
location_change.cost_type_local: 过路费约60-80元/单程（两人均摊约30-40元/人）
location_change.notes_base: Self-drive from Lijiang to Dali via G5611 Dali-Li Expressway. Distance: 169.6 km. Drive time: approximately 130 minutes (2h10m) per Gaode Maps (7828 seconds / 60 = 130 min). Depart ~09:00 after hotel checkout, arrive Dali ~11:10 for afternoon exploring Dali Old Town. Highway tolls approximately CNY 60-80 each way. The scenic route passes through Heqing and follows the Yunling mountain range — beautiful mountain terrain with optional stops. Note: Allow extra buffer time in summer peak season. Rental car continues to be used in Dali for Erhai circuit (Day 7) and Xizhou visit (Day 8). Data source: gaode_maps
location_change.notes_local: 自驾走G5611大丽高速，全程约169.6公里，高德地图预计行驶时间约130分钟（7828秒/60≈130分钟）。约09:00退房出发，约11:10抵达大理古城，下午游览大理古城。单程过路费约60-80元。沿途经过鹤庆，沿云岭山脉行驶，风景优美，可按需停车拍照。暑期旺季建议预留额外时间应对可能拥堵。租车继续用于大理第7天（环洱海）和第8天（喜洲）。数据来源：gaode_maps

route_1.name_base: Erhai Lake Circuit by Rental Car (Dali Old Town → Shuanglang → Xizhou → Return)
route_1.name_local: 租车环洱海（大理古城 → 双廊 → 喜洲 → 返回）
route_1.departure_point_base: Dali Old Town (start from parked rental car)
route_1.departure_point_local: 大理古城（从停车场取车出发）
route_1.arrival_point_base: Shuanglang Ancient Town (via Erhai east shore circuit)
route_1.arrival_point_local: 双廊古镇（经洱海东岸环线）
route_1.cost_type_base: Included in 7-day rental (petrol: approx. CNY 50-80 for full circuit; parking at stops: CNY 10-30)
route_1.cost_type_local: 含在7天租期内（环湖油费约50-80元；各景点停车约10-30元）
route_1.notes_base: With the rental car, the Erhai Lake circuit is easy and flexible. Full circuit approximately 130km. Recommended day route: Dali Old Town → Erhai East Shore (via G214 or lake road) → Shuanglang (双廊, 52.7km, ~74 min) → return via west shore to Dali. Self-drive allows spontaneous stops at lakeside viewpoints, fishing villages, and cafes along the way. The rental car makes it easy to carry beach gear for Shuanglang beach. Petrol for the full Erhai circuit: approximately 3-4L (CNY 25-35). Data source: gaode_maps
route_1.notes_local: 有租车后环洱海自驾非常灵活自由。洱海全程约130公里。推荐路线：大理古城→洱海东岸（走G214或环海路）→双廊古镇（约52.7公里，约74分钟）→沿西岸返回大理古城。自驾可随时在湖边观景台、渔村和咖啡馆停车。去双廊沙滩带换洗装备也方便。环洱海全程耗油约3-4升（约25-35元）。数据来源：gaode_maps

location_change.from_location: Dali Fengyi Airport (大理凤仪机场), Fengyi Town, Dali City
location_change.to_location: Beijing Capital International Airport (北京首都国际机场), Shunyi District, Beijing
location_change.departure_point_base: Dali Fengyi Airport (Rental Car Drop-off + Departure)
location_change.departure_point_local: 大理凤仪机场（还车+出发）
location_change.notes_base: Direct flight, 3h25m. CA1442: depart 19:30, arrive Beijing 22:55. Drive rental car from Dali Old Town to Dali Fengyi Airport — distance 24.5km, approximately 45 minutes. Return the rental car at airport counter upon arrival (rental period ends today: Day 3 pickup to Day 9 drop-off = 7 days). Depart Dali Old Town no later than 16:30 to allow time for car return + check-in + security (target airport arrival by 17:30). Morning in Dali Old Town is free for one last stroll. Alternative if preferring earlier return: CA1500 departing 09:55, arriving 13:25 PEK — but this cuts the last morning short. Baggage: 23kg checked + 8kg carry-on per person. Book 4-6 weeks in advance. Data source: duffel_flights
location_change.notes_local: 直飞航班，飞行时间约3小时25分钟。CA1442：19:30出发，22:55抵达北京首都机场。开租车从大理古城到大理凤仪机场约24.5公里，约45分钟。到机场后在柜台还车（租车期满：第3天丽江取车至第9天大理还车，共7天）。建议不晚于16:30离开大理古城（目标17:30到机场，预留还车+值机+安检时间）。上午可在大理古城悠闲享受最后时光。若想早点回京也可选CA1500（09:55出发，13:25抵京），但会缩短最后一个上午。建议提前4-6周预订。数据来源：duffel_flights

route_1.name_base: Dali Old Town to Dali Fengyi Airport (Rental Car Drop-off)
route_1.name_local: 大理古城 → 大理凤仪机场（还租车）
route_1.departure_point_base: Dali Old Town accommodation (parked rental car)
route_1.departure_point_local: 大理古城住所（停车场取车）
route_1.arrival_point_base: Dali Fengyi Airport — Car Rental Return Counter
route_1.arrival_point_local: 大理凤仪机场租车还车柜台
route_1.cost_type_base: Included in 7-day rental (Day 3 pickup to Day 9 drop-off = 7 days)
route_1.cost_type_local: 含在7天租期内（第3天丽江取车至第9天大理还车，共7天）
route_1.notes_base: Drive rental car from Dali Old Town to Dali Fengyi Airport. Distance: 24.5km, approximately 45 minutes (Gaode Maps: 2710 seconds / 60 = 45 min). Return car at airport rental counter and proceed to departure hall. For 19:30 flight, depart Dali Old Town by 16:30. Allow 15-20 minutes for car return documentation. Data source: gaode_maps
route_1.notes_local: 自驾租车从大理古城到大理凤仪机场，全程约24.5公里，约45分钟（高德地图：2710秒/60≈45分钟）。到机场后在租车公司柜台办理还车手续，再前往出发大厅。针对19:30航班，建议不晚于16:30离开大理古城。预留15-20分钟办理还车手续。数据来源：gaode_maps
